glass_btn_disabled.deviation: canvas 104 x 70, not 100 x 70: with margins 2 / 32 the centre slice is 70 px, a whole number of 10 px dash periods, so axis_stretch_horizontal TILE repeats it without a seam (100 x 70 left a 66 px centre). The CSS stripes run under the whole half-transparent fill, where the fill's backdrop-filter blur(10px) averages them to a uniform haze; without blur they would show as hard stripes across the label, so the interior bakes the averaged haze and only the ring is dashed. Margins and the 30 px arrow are as specified.
glass_btn_disabled.serves: G3 chevron button, disabled: the 1.5 px edge dashed (edge-dim, 6 on / 4 off from the left end, so the left end is solid), fill rgba(8,13,32,.50) over the averaged stripe haze rgba(glow,.15).

glass_btn_focus.deviation: plan 0.4 P5: an OVERLAY, drawn by Godot over the state box (Button, OptionButton, LineEdit and TabBar draw `focus` / `tab_focus` after the state style); it carries only what focus adds, never the dark base, so a focused pressed row still reads as pressed. Spec 6.4 describes the full look.
glass_btn_focus.notes: the lit edge (100-degree #FFD45C -> rgba(glow,.55)), the focus wash (100-degree rgba(glow,.34) -> .07 at 75 %, no dark base) and the 14 px glow (0 0 14 rgba(glow,.55), Gaussian sigma 7) outside the chevron only. Over glass_btn_normal it lands within a few units of the CSS focus fill.
glass_btn_focus.serves: G3 chevron button, focus: the overlay Godot draws over the state box.

glass_btn_hover.deviation: addition (not in 6.4): the overlay split of plan 0.4 P5 leaves no full focused box, and the spec's hover = focus (AC8) needs one where hover does not imply focus.
glass_btn_hover.serves: G3 chevron button, the full CSS focus look as one box (edge, fill, glow): for a theme `hover` that cannot rely on the decor grabbing focus on mouse-enter. Hovered AND focused then draws the overlay on top of it (a brighter wash); prefer hover = glass_btn_normal plus focus-on-hover.

glass_btn_normal.notes: edge-dim edge; fill rgba(8,13,32,.90) under the 100-degree wash rgba(glow,.10) -> 0 at 55 %. The washes and the focus edge are laid out for a 560 x 68 button (they follow the stretched width; a 290 px compact button lands within 3 % of its own CSS stop).
glass_btn_normal.serves: G3 chevron button, normal (and hover / hover_pressed when the decor grabs focus on mouse-enter): TemporalGlassButton, PulpButton, PulpButtonCompact; one texture serves 58-70 px heights.

glass_btn_pressed.deviation: plan 0.4 P5: the interior is solved so that it composes with the focus overlay into the CSS pressed look (spec 6.4 bakes the CSS pressed fill directly); the edge band keeps edge-dim.
glass_btn_pressed.serves: G3 chevron button, pressed / hover_pressed. Built to sit UNDER glass_btn_focus: a pressed button is (almost always) focused, and pressed + the focus overlay equals the CSS focused-pressed fill (rgba(glow,.50) -> .16 over rgba(8,16,38,.92)) exactly; alone it reads as a dimmer pressed fill.

glass_btn_selected.serves: G3 chevron button, selected / toggled (the current value in a list): edge `edge` @0.55, the normal fill. The decor swaps it in for `normal` (as the pulp decor swapped its paper plate).

glass_icons.notes: One white 64 x 64 texture per glyph and weight (a 32-unit grid baked at 2x), its glow baked in, tinted by modulate. Glyphs the spec draws in one weight have a derived bold (strokes x1.5; a solid glyph's bold is its regular art). shield_off is the block pip with no glow (the CSS off pip). The slot-lock overlays are lock_dormant and lock_suppressed (dormant and cross are the plain glyphs). Sources: tools/asset_src/glass/icons_src/ (the spec's 52 SVGs plus beacon_anchor_hollow, plan 0.4 P4).
glass_icons.rule: UI_SPEC_GLASS 3.5 / AC23: the bold weight below 30 px display size, the regular at 30 px and above

glass_kit_about.note: TG-ART Temporal Glass kit (UI_SPEC_GLASS, plan docs/UI_GLASS_2026-10-26_PLAN.md 2.3). Files are relative to res://assets/sprites/ui/glass/. Every PNG is imported with mipmaps. Nine-slices draw at 1:1 corners; `focus` textures are overlays drawn over the state box (plan 0.4 P5). Rebuild: tools/asset_src/glass/build_all.ps1 (holding D:/Projects/.ftt-gdunit-lock).

glass_option_arrow.serves: OptionButton arrow (3.3): chevron_down in the bold weight rasterized at its 18 px display size (an OptionButton draws its arrow at the texture's own size), its generic glow baked (sigma 2.5 x 18 / 64). Baked in ink2 / ink, so the theme's modulate_arrow, which tints it by the field's font colour, lands it on ink2 at rest (7.2), brighter when the field is lit and dimmer when disabled.

glass_panel.deviation: 6.4 suggests placing the edge stops at the slice boundaries (the top-left corner patch .95 -> .22, the bottom-right .10 -> .62). Measured over the 17 panel sizes the screens use, that leaves the edge hairline a mean 0.189 alpha off the CSS (worst 0.271, the 1500 x 200 dialogue box; the Vitals panel's left edge .44 where the CSS draws .78). Laying both gradients out for the 620 x 214 Vitals panel cuts it to 0.066 (worst 0.144, the 680 x 769 pause panel). Canvas, slab, margins and expand margins are as specified.
glass_panel.notes: 96 x 96 slab at (22, 8): chamfer 18 TL/BR; the 1.5 px edge with the 128-degree gradient (rgba(glow,.95) 0, .22 24 %, .10 58 %, .62 100 %); the build fill 160 deg rgba(15,24,52,.92) -> rgba(6,10,26,.95) over the edge layer, which shows through as in the CSS; the drop shadow (0, 14), Gaussian sigma 11, #00020C @0.60. Both gradients are laid out for the 620 x 214 Vitals panel through the nine-slice stretch (exact there, the CSS's trend elsewhere). The sheen and the two streak lines are NOT baked (GlassSheen draws them from the panel's own rect).
glass_panel.serves: G1 glass slab (PNL-A): every panel preset (InkPanel, DialogueGlassPanel, GlassPanel*), the default Panel and PanelContainer. Content margins are the paddings, one variation per preset (3.1).

glass_select_vignette.serves: CARD-A select pool (1.3): radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 45%, rgba(3,5,16,.55), transparent 80%). Draw it as a full-screen TextureRect with stretch mode KeepAspectCovered: the texture's 256:168 aspect is the CSS ellipse's 1152:756, so its UV circle lands as that ellipse centred at (960, 486). (Stretched with Scale, the x extent stays exact and the y extent is 14 % short.)

glass_slider_grabber.deviation: canvas 44 x 44 (TG-ART drew 64 x 64): a Slider is as tall as its grabber icon, so the 64 px canvas made every Settings slider row 64 tall; at 44 the glow is clipped to the canvas, fading over its last 3 px, and a slider stands in a 44 px field like the option buttons (TG-CLOSE).
glass_slider_grabber.serves: HSlider / VSlider grabber and grabber_highlight icon (3.3): the 31.7 px white diamond (a 28 px square rotated 45 degrees and scaled .8), its accent ring (3 px before the .8 scale, 2.4 px drawn) and the 16 px accent glow (sigma 6.4 drawn), centred. Not tinted.

glass_tab.serves: G14 tab, unselected (TabBar / TabContainer tab_unselected, tab_disabled): fill rgba(glow,.08), the 16 px slant on the right (the top edge is the shorter); text T55 (TabLabel).

glass_tab_focus.deviation: plan 0.4 P5: an OVERLAY, drawn by Godot over the state box (Button, OptionButton, LineEdit and TabBar draw `focus` / `tab_focus` after the state style); it carries only what focus adds, never the dark base, so a focused pressed row still reads as pressed. Spec 6.4 describes the full look. Spec 3.3: a focused tab is the selected look plus this glow.
glass_tab_focus.serves: G14 tab focus (tab_focus): the 14 px gold glow (0 0 14 rgba(glow,.55)) outside the tab shape, over the selected tab Godot already drew.

glass_tab_hover.deviation: addition (not in 6.4): tab_hovered replaces the tab's style, so it needs its own look. TG-ART drew it as the selected look plus the glow, which read as selected (orchestrator: a quieter hover).
glass_tab_hover.serves: G14 tab, hovered (tab_hovered): the unselected tab lit, a fill of rgba(glow,.16) (TabHover) with the 14 px glow outside the shape at .30; its text turns white. Quieter than the selected tab, so a hovered tab never reads as the selected one (TG-CLOSE).

glass_tab_selected.serves: G14 tab, selected: 100-degree #F3C95B -> rgba(glow,.55) (laid out for a 180 px tab); text #04141A (TabSelectedInk).

glass_tag.notes: the 2 px #FFD45C bar, the 90-degree wash rgba(glow,.34) -> .08 (laid out for a 130 px tag, so it ends near .08 at the tag's right end), the 8 px right slant (the bottom edge is the shorter). Stretch horizontally only; the tag is always 24 px tall.
glass_tag.serves: G2 panel tag (PanelTagPlate; PulpTagPlate, PanelTagAnchor, PausePanel): text T07 (PanelTag).
